scope: Installed uppercase GAMEDATA/TRACKS/TRK*/*.FRD files paired with their matching .COL files.
method: Sequentially follows the first per-block read pass in LoadTrackFrdResourceStructures (00419c20), including preceding fixed and count-sized arrays, through each table at block+0x598. For each COLL type-15 segment ordinal, follows the statically verified FRD group/descriptor mapping (segment>>3; descriptor index = segment - block+0x584), then enumerates every strip material entry at descriptor WORD+0 plus strip ordinal. Compares the unsigned material entry byte0 against the matching block+0x598 DWORD count.
limitations: Asset parsing only. The parser stops after the loader first-pass per-block arrays and does not parse later FRD passes, emulate arena allocation/cursor failure, or execute the game. All descriptor strips are included, even entries a runtime search may reject. A zero out-of-range count does not establish successful runtime loading or behavior.
